title: Miami Shared Small-Group Boat Tour: River, Bay & Skyline Views
includes: The captains are licensed by the U.S. Coast Guard to serve as master of a vessel.
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Traveler must be able to get on or off the boat on difficult conditions like low or high tides.
Every passenger, regardless of age, must pay a fare.
policies: Name on reservation must be the one on the boat No Exceptions.
Disruptive passengers may be asked to disembark at another dock in the city at their own expense.
Please arrive on time. The boat waits up to 10 minutes past departure. After that, late arrivals are considered no-shows and are non-refundable.
Trips require a minimum of 3 passengers. If fewer are booked, we'll contact you to reschedule, upgrade to a private trip, or purchase the missing seat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See Miami from the water on a relaxed, 2-hour small-group boat tour limited to just 6 travelers. Avoid the big sightseeing crowds as your USCG-licensed captain navigates from the Miami River into Biscayne Bay, showcasing stunning skyline and waterfront views.

This intimate cruise perfectly combines city sightseeing with a laid-back vibe. Bring your own drinks and music—we provide an onboard cooler with ice, a sound system, and complimentary bottled water. Fuel is included.

Highlights:

- 2-hour scenic cruise of the Miami River & Biscayne Bay.

- Max 6 passengers for a premium, uncrowded experience.

- USCG-licensed captain handles all navigation.

- BYOB-friendly with ice, cooler, and bottled water provided.

Please note: A mandatory $25 per person captain fee is due at checkout/arrival in addition to the booking price.
